info.title: Ontraport Universal API
info.description: Manage contacts, campaigns, payments, and messaging in Ontraport

get.description: Retrieves a list of contacts from Ontraport.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search the contact collection for a string.

schema.description: Search the contact collection for a string.

parameters.name: searchNotes
parameters.description: Search notes for the search string.

schema.description: Search notes for the search string.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: JSON-encoded filter criteria for selecting contacts.

schema.description: JSON-encoded filter criteria for selecting contacts.

parameters.name: listFields
parameters.description: Comma-delimited list of contact fields to return.

schema.description: Comma-delimited list of contact fields to return.

parameters.name: externs
parameters.description: Comma-delimited list of related external fields to return.

schema.description: Comma-delimited list of related external fields to return.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip before returning results.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.
